notes: Run only in a repository fixture with an explicit non-empty requirements contract.
Do not treat the hook as a global default or as proof that a skill was understood.
Astra-targeted definition; static validation is not a live model benchmark result.
setupQuestions: Which required skill and tool call provide a safe deterministic enforcement fixture?

scenarios.title: Explicit skill-read policy
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether required-skill enforcement stays repository-opt-in and schema-backed.
scenarios.userInput: Use Skill Read Policy in this isolated workspace. Declare one required skill through the schema-backed requirements contract and prove an unread tool call receives advisory guidance. Do not commit, push, publish, or modify remote state.
successChecklist: The policy is activated explicitly rather than through a default engineering profile.
The requirements payload validates and names a marketplace-visible skill.
The check covers both read and unread outcomes without recording private prompt content.
